svg.title: VarMQ priority queue with one worker
svg.desc: Priority queue starts empty and one worker is idle. Job A is added and dispatched to Worker 1 right away. While Worker 1 is busy, job B with priority 1 and job C with priority 0 are added; C's signal is dropped because B's is still pending. Lower number means higher priority, so C moves ahead of B in the queue. When Worker 1 finishes, the event loop dispatches C first, then B. After the last job the queue is empty and the event loop waits for the next signal.
